errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the purple line (China) rises from its starting point. The chart clearly shows a continuous downward trend for this line from 2025 to 2039.
The description states the purple line starts at about 63,000 Euro/MW, but the chart shows it starts at 65,000 Euro/MW.
The description states the purple line falls to about 65,000 Euro/MW. This is incorrect; the line starts at 65,000 Euro/MW and falls to approximately 42,000 Euro/MW by 2039.
